proposed_status: *STATUS: ANALYSIS 2026-10-22 -- the open half was priced the day it was named, and what it found is a trade, not a task. Level Factory 0.101.0 (c28fae3, 2026-09-21, `tools/warmup_spacing_sweep.py`) swept the warm-up's station set on cold run 9066's package, one cold and one warm launch per configuration, RTX 2060 on GL Compatibility: cold load 40.7 s at 9 stations, 48.6 s at 21, 52.1 s at 29 and 50.2 s at 79, so the ~48 s is the level's shader compile bill pulled forward rather than the sweep's frames, and no station set removes it; lap 1's worst cold frame plateaus at 148-159 ms above ~16 stations; the warm launch is the one that tunes, and `grid_spacing_m` ships at 40.0 (21 stations, 6.4-6.5 s warm load, 20.1-20.5 ms; `level_factory/assets/godot/warmup.gd:132`, its measurements in every package's `warmup.json`, cold run 9378's included). Left as a standing trade: a first launch on a cold driver cache pays the compile bill once per machine and driver, behind `warmup_finished` where a host can show its own loading screen (warmup.gd:62-64); every figure is one GPU's, and the magnitudes elsewhere wait for runtime data.
